audit_trail.plain_language_finding: PLACEHOLDER 4 travelers, 2 drivers (one under 25), Wed Nov 25 to Sun Nov 29, return to the same place, near DFW or Love Field. What matters most to you: lowest total cost.
PLACEHOLDER Asked OctoTrip for cars from 6 rental companies near DFW and Love Field.
PLACEHOLDER 5 of 6 rental companies answered. Rental Co F didn't respond in time, so I couldn't check it. That doesn't mean it has no cars.
PLACEHOLDER OctoTrip didn't return fees for Rental Co C and Rental Co D, so I used their prices saved at 1:15 PM.
PLACEHOLDER Got the full price for 7 options, including airport fees, taxes, extra-driver and young-driver fees, plus the cost of getting to each branch.
